children: New Delhi: Juniper Hotels has agreed to acquire Novotel Imagicaa hotel from Imagicaaworld Entertainment, formerly Adlabs Entertainment, for 248 crore or about 86 lakh per key.

The deal is subject to meeting definitive deal terms and conditions. The 11-acre property is located in Khopoli, Maharashtra, near both Mumbai and Pune. It is adjacent to the Imagicaa Theme Park and Water Park.

Spanning a built-up area of around 2,80,000 sq ft, the hotel has 287 guest rooms besides restaurants, banquet and meeting venues, spa and recreational facilities. Juniper said the acquisition has advanced its 'long-term' objective of building a portfolio of large, high-quality hotels in India's most 'compelling' business and leisure destinations.-Our Bureau

title: Juniper Hotels to Acquire 287-key Novotel Imagicaa for 248 crore
